title: Assemble final V1 release evidence and close only when gates pass
steps: Reconcile the exact release-candidate head, all successor test suites and the accountability checklist.
Verify schema migration/replay fixtures, trust-boundary negatives, PWA artifact/package evidence and Android evidence where available.
Confirm browser/mobile accessibility, visual, rights/provenance, moderation, governance and operational acceptance records.
Record commit, tag, checksums, artifacts, smoke outputs and release owners only after the preceding gates pass.
Keep the release closed beta and do not tag V1 while any required gate remains pending.
acceptance: A complete exact-head V1 evidence package exists, every success criterion is proven, or the release remains explicitly pending with named blockers.
